rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates how much landlords may raise rent through a Rent Leveling Board process; landlords must apply for annual, capital-improvement, vacancy, or hardship rent increases, and tenants may challenge rents they believe are illegal. Buildings with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to multi-unit rental buildings registered with the city; five-or-more unit buildings must file annual registration statements and rent increase applications through the city's permitting system.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; other exemptions may apply per the ordinance's criteria (subject to a Rent Control Exemption Request).
rules.citation: Jersey City Code ch. 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the property owner has filed for and met criteria for a Rent Control Exemption Request

rules.conflict_note: Exact rent increase percentage/formula not stated in retrieved passages; only coverage exemptions and administrative process are described.
